image_description: A rural agricultural scene featuring two dark-colored oxen pulling a traditional wooden plow through a tilled field. A farmer in a red vest and yellow shirt walks behind the plow, guiding it. In the background, there are rustic log-cabin style buildings and green trees on a hillside. The ground is brown earth with visible furrows.
